value.rationale: A natural unresolved dynamical question is whether strong first-order clock regularity ensures a long-run output rate. An exact four-gap minimality theorem and threshold-resolved counterexample show that the order of gaps matters even with identical marginal statistics and bounded graininess, and can force a whole continuum of rate limit points. The invariant is motivated by temporal sampling reliability, not an arbitrary isolated calculation.
